company.name: PayPay
company.shortDescription: PayPay is a fintech company that designs and operates a digital platform to facilitate online transactions and mobile payments.
company.description: PayPay is a cashless payment application that allows users to make payments easily with just their smartphones. Registration is quick, taking just about a minute. It can be used at local shops, online services, and for paying bills. The company offers campaigns that allow users to purchase items at discounted rates, making shopping more economical.

productsAndServices.description: A smartphone app enabling cashless payments via QR code scanning or barcode display for in-store, online, and bill payments.

productsAndServices.description: Digital coupons that users can acquire in advance and automatically apply discounts or benefits during payments at participating stores and online shops.
productsAndServices.name: PayPay Coupons

productsAndServices.description: A payment option allowing users to pay for purchases on credit with monthly consolidated billing, eliminating the need for pre-charging.
productsAndServices.name: PayPay Credit Payment Method

productsAndServices.description: A service enabling users to pay public utility and other bills by scanning barcodes or using QR codes through the PayPay app.
productsAndServices.name: PayPay Bill Payment Service

productsAndServices.description: A loyalty program where users earn points from payments and campaigns, which can be used for future purchases or point-based investment simulations.
